name: Harmony
source:
It is a time of war between two great powers that have divided the world.
The armies are led by girls known as "divas"
who display mysterious powers through their singing.
The outcome of the war is determined by their songs.
One day,a diva loses her voice
in battle and embarks on a journey to regain it along with her song.
translation:
这是分裂世界的两个大国之间的战争时期。
军队由被称为“天后”的女孩领导
他们通过歌声展现出神秘的力量。
战争的胜负由他们的歌曲决定。
有一天，一位女主角失去了声音
在战斗中，伴随着歌声踏上了夺回它的旅程。
